help:
🤖 *Trackzoon Bot Help*

Here are all the commands you can use:
settingsMessage:
⚙️ *Bot Settings*

Customize your bot experience with the options below:
startMessage: Welcome to Trackzoon Bot! I help you track Amazon product prices and get alerts for drops. Use the buttons below or commands to get started!
invalidThreshold: Invalid threshold price. Please provide a positive number.

addProduct.title: 📦 \*Add New Product\*
addProduct.instruction: Send me the Amazon product URL you want to track\. I\'ll help you set up price alerts\!

tips.title: 💡 \*Helpful Tips:\*
tips.validUrl: • Make sure it\'s a valid Amazon product page
tips.copy: • Copy \& paste the full URL from your browser
tips.asin: • The URL should contain a product ID \(ASIN\)

promptForUrl: Please send me the Amazon product URL you want to track.
exampleUrlHint: Tip: paste a full Amazon product page URL (e.g. https://www.amazon.eg/dp/B08...)
promptForThreshold: Now, please send me the threshold price (e.g., 100.50) you want to be alerted at.
promptNewThresholdNoCurrentPrice: Please enter the new threshold price for the product.
promptNewThresholdWithCurrentPrice: Current price: {{currentPrice}} EGP. Choose a threshold or enter a custom one:
manageProductActions: Choose an action for the product below:
errorAddingProduct: There was an error adding the product. Please try again.
promptForUrlPercentage: Please send me the Amazon product URL you want to track with a percentage drop.
promptForPercentage: What percentage drop would you like to be notified about?
promptForCustomPercentage: Please enter a custom percentage between 1 and 100.
errorProcessingUrl: Sorry, there was an error processing that URL. Please make sure it's a valid Amazon product URL.
errorFetchingPrice: Sorry, I couldn't fetch the current price for this product. Please try again later.
invalidState: Sorry, something went wrong. Please start over with the /add_percentage command.
